description:
Fit a camera to the world bounds of some nodes and render them with the scene's real environment and lights; bookmark_name also saves the pose. Returns the image and a caption with the pose and bounds.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/frame-nodes"}

aspect.description: Frame width/height (default 1.7778 = 16:9). Every tile uses it.

bookmark_name.description: Also save the fitted pose as this camera bookmark (1-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -), so later renders line up with it.

direction.description: Side the camera sits on: "front" (+Z), "back" (-Z), "left" (-X), "right" (+X), "top", "iso" (default, 3/4 from -X,+Y,-Z like summer_screenshot). Use from for anything else.

fill.description: Share of the frame the nodes span along their limiting dimension (0.1..1.5, default 0.8).

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees (default 50).

from.description: Explicit direction FROM the nodes TOWARD the camera, "Vector3(1, 0.4, 2)". Replaces direction.

marks.description: Numbered Set-of-Mark labels over the largest visible nodes; the caption maps label -> node path (feed a label to summer_zoom mark).

max_marks.description: marks only: cap on labels (engine default 32).

max_size.description: Longest edge of the returned JPEG in pixels (default 1024). Bigger costs more context; up to 4096 for detail work on a PC.

nodes.description: Node paths relative to the scene root ("House1", "Props/Crate_02"). The camera fits their combined WORLD bounds (visible meshes, children included).

scenePath.description: Scene to look at, e.g. "res://levels/town.tscn" (the SAVED file). Omit for the scene open in the editor.

name: summer_frame_nodes
title: Frame nodes and render them
